products.description: This set of two hiking poles balances strength and lightness for confident trekking across varied terrain. shipping.title: Shipping policy
shipping.body: Orders placed before 2pm ET on a business day ship the same day; later orders ship the next business day. US standard shipping (3–5 business days) is $9, free on orders of $150 or more after discounts. US express (1–2 business days) is $24. Canada, UK, EU and Vietnam: flat $24, 7–14 business days, duties may be charged by the destination country. We cannot change the shipping address after an order has shipped; before that, contact support and we will update it.

returns.title: Returns & exchanges
returns.body: Unworn items with tags attached can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Exchanges for a different size or colour are free. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days after we receive the return. Items marked Final Sale and used socks cannot be returned. Return shipping is free in the US; international customers pay return shipping.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.body: Shells, backpacks and trekking poles carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects (zippers, seams, buckles, locking mechanisms). Wear and tear, accidents and misuse are not covered. Send photos and your order number to support to start a claim.

sizing.title: Sizing guide
sizing.body: Shell jackets fit true to size with room for a light mid-layer; if you plan to wear a heavy fleece underneath, size up. Items with 'oversized' in the name have a relaxed fit — size down for a regular fit. Bottoms: waists run slightly small according to customer feedback, so if you are between sizes choose the larger one.

wholesale.title: Wholesale & clubs
wholesale.body: Approved wholesale accounts (guiding companies, clubs, retailers) get automatic tiered pricing at checkout: 10% off at 12+ units, 15% off at 24+ units, 20% off at 48+ units. Apply via the wholesale form; approval takes 1–2 business days.

discounts.title: Discounts & price matching
discounts.body: Newsletter subscribers get 10% off their first order with the code sent by email. We do not price match and we do not offer other discount codes through chat. Only one discount code can be used per order.
